Gifted: Warp.name: Gifted: Warp
Gifted: Warp.description:
🧬 Warp, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start gates reach about fifty meters to a spot you can see or have stood in; small ones strike from odd angles, door-sized ones carry you and a companion out.
📈 With training: attacks sent back, peeks into sealed rooms, crowd exits, villains sent far from hostages, the city crossed in a step, command of every door in a building.
⚠️ Warp users are rare, and agencies, the Commission and villains all track them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding two places in mind wears you down.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kurogiri (Warp Gate).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Warp.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Warp family): Scale: two linked gates, one beside the user and one at a spot they can picture (in sight or once stood on); what enters one leaves the other. At first: about fifty meters, at most door-sized, open a few seconds, one pair at a time. More needs learned techniques. Limits: a gate takes a moment to open and works both ways, so quick foes can dodge, follow through or shoot back. Gates never open inside solid matter or a person and never cut: a closing gate pushes anything halfway through back out. Losing focus shuts every gate. Quirk Strain: light: small gates, short step; moderate: turning an attack aside, peephole, group exit; heavy: sending someone away, crossing the city; severe: signature collapse, taking every door in a building. Type: Emitter. Law: moving a person through a gate without consent is abduction; the Commission tracks every registered warp user.
